facts.fact: The ANEC presentation of May 2025 describes NEKKAL delivering civil-status acts in electronic form authenticated by QR code and electronic signature, and offering online identity verification, with a demonstration of the tools.

The ANEC presentation of May 2025 shows NEKKAL's civil-status information system exchanging with the identity directorate, health (electronic notification of births and deaths), the statistics agency and the electoral file, with online identity verification.

facts.fact: The ANEC presentation cites the fifth general population census (RGPH-5, 2023), carried out by the national statistics agency ANSD.

facts.fact: The ANEC presentation of May 2025 describes the NEKKAL civil-status modernisation as equipping centres with 1,200 computers and a management application, digitising and indexing 20 million acts, and interconnecting 400 centres.
